llm.summary: This is a coherent real-estate calculator and skill-template kit, with some setup and scoping cautions but no evidence of hidden exfiltration or destructive behavior.

dimensions.detail: The calculator code reads local rules and optional user templates; one template loader accepts absolute or existing JSON paths, which is broader than the managed template directory but not paired with network exfiltration or automatic scanning.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The installer is user-run and copies a rendered skill into a detected or supplied agent skills directory, then writes a sha256 marker; this is disclosed and purpose-aligned.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Several generated-skill templates and examples use broad real-estate trigger keywords and sales/CRM workflows, so generated skills should narrow activation rules before production use.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistence is limited to installed skill files and optional saved JSON templates under the toolkit directory; no background worker, privilege escalation, credential use, or auto-start mechanism was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently describe a real-estate skill kit: command-line calculators, city rule data, and templates for branded advisory/sales workflows.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only if you need real-estate calculation or branded real-estate assistant templates. Before using generated sales or CRM skills with real customers or business systems, narrow the trigger keywords, verify adapter permissions, and avoid passing arbitrary --template paths unless you trust the JSON file.
llm.findings:
[SDI-2] unexpected: Confirmed that the user-template loader can open absolute or existing JSON paths. Custom templates are purpose-aligned, but this path handling is broader than necessary and should be used only with trusted files.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Confirmed a mismatch between managed-template framing and the ability to load external JSON paths; this is an under-disclosure issue, not evidence of hidden data transfer.
[SQP-1] expected: Confirmed broad real-estate trigger language in the root skill and generated examples. It may cause over-activation, but the behavior remains within the stated real-estate skill-kit purpose.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Confirmed there is no explicit consent prompt before loading an external template path. The access is user-directed through CLI arguments and no network or credential handling was found.
[SQP-2] expected: Confirmed the sub-brokerage module discusses bulk notices, acknowledgments, and operational data collection. This is expected for channel management, and the template includes least-privilege/confidentiality language, though production deployments should add concrete authorization and audit controls.
